```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.path = "../figures/", dpi = 200)
library(GEOquery); library(tidyverse); library(limma)
library(pheatmap); library(clusterProfiler); library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(glmnet); library(caret); library(pROC)
```

# 1. Data import

```{r import}
gse   <- getGEO("GSE51808", GSEMatrix = TRUE)[[1]]
expr  <- exprs(gse)
meta  <- pData(gse)
fdata <- fData(gse)
cat("Probes x samples:", dim(expr), "\n")
```

# 2. Sample groups (acute DF vs DHF only)

```{r group}
# join all the label columns of each sample into one text string
cols <- c(intersect(c("title", "source_name_ch1"), colnames(meta)),
          grep("^characteristics_ch1", colnames(meta), value = TRUE))
lab <- apply(meta[, cols, drop = FALSE], 1, paste, collapse = " | ")

meta$severity <- case_when(
  str_detect(lab, regex("DHF|hemorrhagic|haemorrhagic", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "DHF",
  str_detect(lab, regex("\\bDF\\b|dengue fever", ignore_case = TRUE))        ~ "DF",
  str_detect(lab, regex("healthy|control|normal", ignore_case = TRUE))       ~ "Healthy",
  TRUE ~ "Other")
meta$phase <- ifelse(str_detect(lab, regex("conval", ignore_case = TRUE)),
                     "convalescent", "acute")

print(table(meta$severity, meta$phase))   # expect DF acute 18, DHF acute 10

keep  <- meta$severity %in% c("DF", "DHF") & meta$phase == "acute"
expr  <- expr[, keep]
meta  <- meta[keep, ]
meta$group <- meta$severity
print(table(meta$group))                  # expect DF 18, DHF 10
```

# 3. Quality control

```{r qc-before, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
if (max(expr, na.rm = TRUE) > 50) expr <- log2(expr + 1)
cat("Missing values:", sum(is.na(expr)), "\n")
par(mar = c(6, 4, 3, 1))
boxplot(as.data.frame(expr), las = 2, cex.axis = 0.5,
        main = "Before normalisation", ylab = "log2 expression")
```

```{r qc-after, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
expr <- normalizeBetweenArrays(expr, method = "quantile")
par(mar = c(6, 4, 3, 1))
boxplot(as.data.frame(expr), las = 2, cex.axis = 0.5,
        main = "After normalisation", ylab = "log2 expression")
```

```{r filter}
v <- apply(expr, 1, var)
expr_f <- expr[v > median(v), ]
cat("Probes before:", nrow(expr), " after:", nrow(expr_f), "\n")
```

# 4. Exploratory analysis

```{r pca}
pca <- prcomp(t(expr_f), scale. = TRUE)
pca_df <- data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2], group = meta$group)
ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = group)) + geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() + ggtitle("PCA of blood expression profiles")
```

```{r heatmap, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
top <- names(sort(apply(expr_f, 1, var), decreasing = TRUE))[1:50]
ann <- data.frame(group = meta$group, row.names = colnames(expr_f))
pheatmap(expr_f[top, ], annotation_col = ann,
         show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE)
```

```{r cluster, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
plot(hclust(dist(t(expr_f))), labels = meta$group, cex = 0.6,
     main = "Sample clustering")
```
# 5. Differential expression (DHF vs DF)

```{r limma}
group  <- factor(meta$group, levels = c("DF", "DHF"))
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
colnames(design) <- levels(group)

fit  <- lmFit(expr_f, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, makeContrasts(DHF - DF, levels = design)))
deg  <- topTable(fit2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")

# gene-symbol column in the annotation table (name differs by platform)
sym_col <- grep("symbol", colnames(fdata), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
cat("Symbol column used:", sym_col, "\n")
deg$symbol <- fdata[rownames(deg), sym_col]

# main cut-off: adjusted P < 0.05 and |log2 fold change| > 0.5
sig <- deg[deg$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(deg$logFC) > 0.5, ]
cutoff_used <- "adjusted P < 0.05 and |logFC| > 0.5"

# with only 28 samples this can be empty or tiny, so use a fallback
if (nrow(sig) < 20) {
  sig <- deg[deg$P.Value < 0.01 & abs(deg$logFC) > 0.5, ]
  cutoff_used <- "nominal P < 0.01 and |logFC| > 0.5 (fallback)"
}
cat("Cut-off used:", cutoff_used, "\n")
cat("Significant probes:", nrow(sig),
    "| up in DHF:", sum(sig$logFC > 0),
    "| down in DHF:", sum(sig$logFC < 0), "\n")

dir.create("../results", showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(deg, "../results/DEG_table.csv")
head(deg[, c("symbol", "logFC", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val")], 10)
```

```{r volcano, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
deg$status <- ifelse(rownames(deg) %in% rownames(sig), "Significant", "Not significant")
ggplot(deg, aes(logFC, -log10(P.Value), colour = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Significant" = "red", "Not significant" = "grey60")) +
  theme_bw() + labs(title = "Volcano plot: DHF vs DF",
                    x = "log2 fold change (DHF - DF)", y = "-log10(P value)")
```
